corporate_events.detail:
Waktu: 14:00:00 · Lokasi: DKI Jakarta, Secara Elektronik Melalui Fasilitas Electronic General Meeting System Ksei Dalam Yang Disediakan Oleh PT Kustodian Sentralefek Indonesia · Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements audited by KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja, granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a net profit allocation of Rp7.2 trillion, designating 70% as cash dividends and 30% as retained earnings.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries, honoraria, and facilities for the company's management for 2025 and 2026.
Agenda #4: KAP Purwanto Susanti dan Surja (Ernst & Young Global Limited) was appointed to audit the 2026 Consolidated Financial Statements and PUMK reports.
Agenda #5: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Company Plan and the 2027 Work Plan and Budget after obtaining written approval from Series B Shareholders.
Agenda #6: The meeting accepted the report regarding the realization of state capital participation funds and proceeds from the Limited Public Offering I through a rights issue.
Agenda #7: The company received approval to accept special assignments from the Central Government to accelerate nickel downstreaming and the electric vehicle battery ecosystem.
Agenda #8: Shareholders approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align business activities with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI).
